title: CreeperTrip
description: New mobs, craftable Creeper Leather/Faces, colorful glowing Creeper Blocks, Steel Ore with powerful Tools/Armor, and the legendary Creeper Punch that mines everything instantly.
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Zb6qqszgZw0" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

**Only the "Jeeper Creeper" explodes — the other new creepers do NOT explode!**  
This keeps the game balanced and fun instead of pure chaos. More explosions and new features will come with future updates!

CreeperTrip is my very first mod — I learned modding from scratch and built the whole thing in just 3– 4 days. Now I could do something like this in 1–2 days, and the mod will keep growing with every update!

Two versions available:
- **CreeperTrip 1.0 (with monsters)** – full experience with all new mobs  
- **CreeperTrip 1.0 (without monsters)** – only new items, blocks, ore, tools, armor (perfect if you just want the building/crafting part)

### New Mobs (only in the "with monsters" version)
- **Creeperman**  
  Walks and behaves like a player (humanoid), attacks you, but does **NOT** explode. Drops Creeper Meat and sometimes rare items.
- **Ghost Creeper**  
  Burns in sunlight like a zombie, looks creepy-transparent, drops coal sometimes, does **NOT** explode.
- **Jeeper Creeper (Big Creeper)**  
  Bigger version of the normal creeper — **this is the only one that still explodes!** Bigger explosion radius, scary but fair.

### New Items & Drops
- **Creeper Meat** – dropped by all new creepers, heals you when eaten (does NOT explode in your face!)
- **Creeper Leather** – craftable or rare drop (Leather + Gunpowder + Soul Sand)
- **Creeper Face** – smelt Soul Sand + Creeper Leather in a furnace → Creeper Face
- **Golden Creeper Leather** – Creeper Leather + Gold Nugget in crafting grid

### New Blocks
- **Creeper Block** – 9 Creeper Leather → solid decorative block
- **Creeper Face Block** (6 colors + glowing!)  
  Craft Creeper Block + dye (Redstone = red, Coal = black, Bone Meal = white, Gold Nugget = yellow, Lapis = blue, Ink Sac = dark gray)  
  → Colored glowing Creeper Face Blocks (glow like Glowstone, perfect for building creepy bases!)
- **Rainbow Creeper Face Block** – combine all 6 colored versions

### New Ore & Metal: Steel
- **Steel Ore** – generates in caves (looks like coal but metallic)
- Smelt → **Steel Ingot**
- Steel tools/weapons are stronger and faster than iron, but not quite diamond level  
  (exactly between iron and gold in strength, but much more durable than gold)

### Upgraded Tools & Weapons
- Craft normal Steel tools first
- Upgrade with Golden Creeper Leather → almost diamond level
- Ultimate upgrade with all 6 colored Creeper Face Blocks → **Rainbow Steel Tools** (as strong and fast as diamond!)
- **Creeper Punch** (the crazy weapon!)  
  Combine 4 brand-new (unbroken) Rainbow Steel tools + specific colored blocks in exact pattern →  
  One-hit kills almost everything, mines EVERY block instantly, nearly unbreakable. Faster than Creative mode!

### Armor
- **Steel Armor** – same protection as iron armor, looks like iron (custom texture)
- **Rainbowic Rainbow Creeper Armor** – crafted with colored Creeper Blocks, full set gives massive protection and looks totally insane

### Compatibility & Installation
- Requires **Forge** (tested with 7.8.0.684)
- Drop the .jar into your **mods** folder
- Works with ModLoader too
- May conflict with other big mods — if you get crashes, try a clean install or remove conflicting mods

### Future Updates (already planned)
- Version 2.0 for Minecraft 1.6+
- Giant Creeper (I had problems with the model, but it's coming!)
- New weapons, new ores, new mobs
- More crazy crafting recipes
- Bug fixes and better textures

I’m totally open to suggestions! Comment here or on the YouTube video if you have cool ideas for new creepers, items or anything else.

Thanks for downloading and have fun exploding (or not exploding)!
